entries.text: Blue: names and reports. Amber: accusations and votes. Teal: defense and support. Purple: counterclaims and refutations. Role badges: Town green, Antagonist red, Neutral orange. A claim is not proof of a role. Selected players have a blue frame; dead players are grey.

TOWN — Decryptor
Investigate one other participant each night. You receive their apparent alignment, which can be affected by forged evidence. Goal: help Town eliminate its threats.

TOWN — Physician
Protect one other participant at night. Protection can stop attacks up to its strength; applying protection does not prove an attack happened. Goal: help Town eliminate its threats.

TOWN — Solarian
No active night ability. Use discussion, reports and votes to find the threats. Cannot claim an acting role. Goal: help Town win.

TOWN — Nullifier
Limited night attacks against one other participant. Passing preserves a charge. Choose carefully: a suspicion is not proof. Goal: help Town win.

TOWN — Watcher
Watch another participant at night. Learn who visited them, not what ability each visitor used. A living counterclaimant is a legal target. Goal: help Town win.

ANTAGONIST — Archon
The faction chooses one night attack. You know your Antagonist teammates. A living player killer controls the team's target or pass. May bluff a Town special role. Goal: secure an Antagonist victory.

ANTAGONIST — Singer
Choose another participant to block at night. A successful block can prevent their action. You know your Antagonist teammates and may bluff a Town special role. Goal: secure an Antagonist victory.

ANTAGONIST — Aperture
Forge evidence against one participant so their investigation appearance becomes Antagonist for that night. You know your teammates and may bluff a Town special role. Goal: secure an Antagonist victory.

NEUTRAL — Anarchy
Make an independent night attack. You have no Antagonist teammate knowledge. Goal: be the last survivor; Anarchy and the night-immune Infinitum alone form a stalemate.

NEUTRAL — Infinitum
No active night ability; immune to night attacks and appears Town to investigations. Goal: survive until a normal Antagonist victory, which you replace. Surviving a Town victory is not your win.

NEUTRAL — Fool
No active night ability. Goal: be executed by the day vote. Dying at night does not fulfill your objective. May bluff a Town special role.
